rater: Codex AI review of all 60 actual generations and 10 prompts
status: exploratory unblinded AI annotations; not independent validation or a human-rated result
humor_rationale: Only explicit playful-jab or having-fun reframings count. Emojis, offering to write a joke and serious replies do not.
relevance_rationale: Generic dismissal replies and misunderstanding whose servers were criticized, or replacing the plagiarism accusation with generic AI ethics, scored zero. Context requests responding to missing conversation details scored one.
coherence_rationale: All continuations are intelligible; truncation at the common 60-token cap is allowed by the frozen rubric. Coherence does not establish truthfulness or general competence.
